answer: Sybil resistance holds when each identity carries an unforgeable cost. Require every agent to post a stake that gets slashed for misbehavior; spinning up a thousand fakes then demands a thousand bonds, and the economic tide turns against the attacker. Reputation accrues slowly, like a terrace built stone by stone over many epochs, and cannot be cloned, so a genuine track record becomes a relic no freshly minted account can counterfeit overnight.
